changeSet.comment: Labels copied from the value's own name by the 3.5.x backfills are not site edits.

changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: The French "Commande" the NCE category file carried before OGC-1507 was loaded, not typed by the lab, so the file's new "Demande" may replace it.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.localization_value lv SET origin = 'SYSTEM' FROM clinlims.nce_category c WHERE c.name_localization_id = lv.localization_id AND c.name = 'Order' AND lv.locale = 'fr' AND lv.value = 'Commande';
